patthana12.18:4.1: Nasaraṇaṃ nacittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasaraṇaṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.18:6.1: Nasaraṇaṃ nacittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasaraṇaṃ nacittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.18:7.1: Nasaraṇaṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasaraṇaṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasaraṇaṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
